prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop homepage composition for Josh King, a product designer. Render only the actual edge-to-edge web page canvas at roughly 1536×1024 landscape—no browser chrome, device, desk, presentation board, mockup frame, or surrounding environment.

This is option 1 of a canvas-first design study: "Quiet lower register." The page is almost entirely near-black (#080909), with an unusually generous, deliberate empty field occupying roughly the upper two-thirds. Use only flat typography, thin rules, whitespace, proportion, and alignment. No imagery of any kind.

At top left, place a restrained wordmark: "JOSH KING" in uppercase Montserrat, warm white (#F2F0E9), small but confident. At top right, a sparse horizontal navigation in DM Sans: "WORK   LAB   ABOUT   CONTACT". Across the lower third, build one wide, low typographic register—NOT a box or card—using baseline alignment and large gaps: "PRODUCT DESIGNER" at left, "DESIGN · CODE · AI" nearer the center, and "VIEW LATEST WORK" at right. Use one short mint (#A7E0C3) underline or active dash beneath VIEW LATEST WORK; mint appears nowhere else. At the very bottom edge, allow the top portion of large text "LATEST WORK" to barely enter the canvas as a precise continuation cue.

The design should feel clean, art-directed, minimal, confident, editorial without using serif type. Font families are Montserrat for display and DM Sans for supporting text. Use flat colors only: near-black, warm white, muted gray, and the single mint active mark. Crisp spacing, strong optical alignment, premium product-design portfolio.

STRICTLY EXCLUDE: photos, screenshots, UI thumbnails, client names, company logos, icons, illustrations, objects, symbols used as metaphors, narrative scenes, textures, noise, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, shadows, cards, panels, rounded rectangles, bento grids, side borders, eyebrow headings, serif fonts, invented awards or claims. Do not include "41 Realty", "The Viv", "Reserve", "StormForge", or any other client brand. Only use this visible copy: JOSH KING; PRODUCT DESIGNER; DESIGN · CODE · AI; VIEW LATEST WORK; WORK; LAB; ABOUT; CONTACT; LATEST WORK.
